description_en: The three-bayed Triratnavihāra Phalcā is attached to the god-house of the Cī Bāhāḥ Nani (LAL1730) on its right-hand side. The Cī Bāhāḥ Nani is one of the branches of the Cīkã Bahī that is located at Cyāsal Ṭola. This Phalcā opens up to the west and rests on five historical baluster columns. The inscription attached to the wall informs its readers that the Phalcā was made by a Bhājuvīra individual and his family in NS 991 (1871 CE). A small window above the middle bay is flanked by wall paintings showing a standing Bhairava performingālīḍhaandpratyālīḍha. Stone statues of Sarasvatī, Gaṇeśa and Lakṣmī line the main wall of the Phalcā. On the day of Śrīpañcamī (5th day of the bright half of Māgha), people worship the Goddess Sasasvatī of this Phalcā and write their name or any other names to be included in their wishes in chalk on its walls.
description_ne: चीबाहाः (त्रिरत्नविहार) च्यासल स्थित चिकं बहीको कचाबाहाःमध्ये एक हो । चीबहाःको द्यःछेँ संग जोडिएर यो फल्चा बनेको छ । ने.सं. ९९१ मा भाजुवीर लगायत उनका अन्य परिवार सदस्यले बनाएको द्यःछेँसंग गाभेर यो फल्चा बनाएको हो भनी द्यःछेँको अभिलेखमा ‘‘धर्मशाला सहित याङं दयकाव’’ भन्ने वाक्यांश परेबाट स्पष्ट हुन्छ । फल्चाको मोहोडा भागको माथिल्लो भित्तामा आलिढ र प्रत्यालिढ आसनमा उभिएका भैरवका दुई भित्तेचित्रहरु छन् । फल्चामा एउटै मूर्ति फलकमा बनेका सरस्वती, गणेश र लक्ष्मीको मूर्ति छ । श्रीपञ्चमीका दिन फल्चाको सरस्वती मूर्तिलाई विशेष पूजा गरी मनले चिताएको शब्द फल्चाको भित्तामा लेख्ने परम्परा चलिआएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)
references: Sources and references Details Summary of the inscription On the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa in NS 991 (1871 CE), a monastery ( vihāra ) called Triratna was constructed together with a rest house ( phalcā ) in front of the caitya located at Saptapurī Mahāvihāra, and a statue of triple gems ( triratna ) was established there on the same day. Triratna Vihāra was constructed by a family (consisting of older brother Bhānuvīra, younger brother Mānavīra and Siddhimāna, and sons and daughters) after having performed worships at all the monasteries of Lalitapura. Further, they donated certain plots of land in different places in order to please Triratna Buddha. It is instructed that the yearly income from the land should be spent on the activities that take place in the monastery.

historical_events.event_description: Bhājuvīr, Mānavīr, Siddhimāna and other members of their families constructed the Phalcā.
